reasons.plausibility: The idea of substituting heavier Hf with lighter Al in a refractory high-entropy alloy to reduce density and maintain strength is scientifically sound, though stability of the BCC phase at higher Al contents remains a minor concern.
reasons.testability: A clear, systematic experiment with varying Al contents and explicit pass/fail criteria provides a straightforward route to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: This approach directly tackles a priority gap—density reduction while preserving high-temperature strength—and offers a well-reasoned, practical path to explore an important alloy development strategy.
